title: RC-27 the two legacy scripts addLiquidity.ts and deploySepoliaTest.ts import compiled artifacts of Solidity sources that no longer exist, so neither can load; behind the broken imports both sign with the bot wallet key on the ALCHEMY_URL network (documented as Ethereum mainnet), and addLiquidity would wrap almost the whole wallet balance into a pool with zero minimums

only contracts/FakeToken.sol, contracts/honeypot/HoneypotChecker.sol and two test fixtures are tracked; no UniswapV2Router02.sol, UniswapV2Factory.sol or interfaces/IWETH.sol source exists at the base, so a compile cannot produce those artifacts

sibling_sites_checked: Every file under scripts/ at the base (slice-files.ts --snapshot SCRIPTS, 10 files) and the three contracts-tooling scripts were searched for artifacts/ and .sol imports: only addLiquidity.ts and deploySepoliaTest.ts import compiled artifacts; deploy-honeypot-checker.ts goes through Hardhat Ignition (ignition/modules/HoneypotChecker.ts, contract present). The other two scripts that write files are capture-launch.ts (test fixtures, AUD-SCRIPTS-009) and no other script writes src/. Nothing under src/ or test/ reads src/addresses.json at the base (git grep addresses.json finds only these two scripts and the ignition deployed_addresses.json files). The five addLiquidity and five deploySepoliaTest signing sites above are also listed in the signer finding AUD-SCRIPTS-002 for the 22-26 signing-site census.
severity_rationale: S3, one step above the research suggestion S4. Not S2 or higher because neither script can run at the base or on this machine: the artifact JSON files do not exist (MODULE_NOT_FOUND), so module resolution fails before main() and no transaction can be signed. Above S4 because the files are misleading rather than merely dead: README.md calls them "Sepolia bootstrap helpers" while both target ALCHEMY_URL (documented as mainnet) with the bot wallet key, against D-DEPLOY-KEY; anyone who "fixes" the imports would get a script that deploys contracts from the trading wallet on mainnet (deploySepoliaTest) or wraps nearly the whole balance into a liquidity pool with zero minimums (addLiquidity). Never NOT-A-BUG (NAC-10).
recommendation: Phase 29 (HYG-03: broken scripts are removed or fixed): decide on card SCRIPTS-03. The recommendation is to delete both scripts (nothing reads src/addresses.json any more and the contracts they deploy are not in the repo). If the operator wants a Sepolia rehearsal tool instead, rebuild it from scratch: read SEPOLIA_RPC_URL, refuse unless the chainId is 11155111, sign with a testnet-only key (never PRIVATE_KEY), match the FakeToken constructor, use non-zero liquidity minimums and write any output file atomically and only after every transaction succeeded.

triage.note: Proven statically (plan 23-13): the directory walk of scripts/ goes to ts.createProgram (options mirroring tsconfig.json, resolveJsonModule) and each script's relative imports are resolved with the compiler's module resolution; exactly addLiquidity and deploySepoliaTest have unresolved imports (claim legacy-scripts-unresolved-artifact-imports, observed ['addLiquidity','deploySepoliaTest'], correct []), every unresolved specifier is a compiled artifact under ../artifacts/contracts/, and each script misses the three artifacts whose Solidity source does not exist (IWETH, UniswapV2Factory, UniswapV2Router02), so neither can load and nothing is signed (FakeToken's artifact varies by machine and changes no row). Sub-claims 2 to 5 (mainnet ALCHEMY_URL with the bot key, the FakeToken constructor mismatch, the zero-minimum liquidity, the partial addresses.json writes) stay code-read. Deleting both scripts, the recommendation (card SCRIPTS-03, HYG-03), flips the claim to looks fixed and flips no other test (fix-shaped mutation, restored from git). Feeds the census exception list in plan 23-17 (the legacy scripts hold 10 of the 12 script exceptions under AUD-SCRIPTS-002); card SCRIPTS-01 stays open (operator, Phase 22).
